Executive & Administrative Officer Job at Dicalo Consulting Group




        
    

        
        Dicalo Consulting Group is a management consulting firm specializing in a range of services, including business management and setup, accounting services, business registration, business consultancy, international tax advisory, and business plan preparation. At Dicalo Consulting, our business practices are guided by a set of core values that shape our approach to conducting business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive & Administrative Officer

Job Location: Ajao Estate, Lagos Mainland - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work mode: On-site

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Executive & Administrative Officer to provide administrative, executive and business support to the organisation.
	The role will coordinate daily office activities, support management and the Board, manage correspondence, assist with customer communication and ensure smooth administrative operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage day-to-day administrative and office activities, including filing, documentation, records and office supplies.
	Manage official emails, correspondence and telephone calls, ensuring timely and professional responses.
	Coordinate meetings, appointments and business engagements, including preparing meeting documents and taking minutes where required.
	Provide administrative support to management and the Board, including following up on assigned action points.
	Respond to customer enquiries, make follow-up calls and maintain professional communication with clients and other stakeholders.
	Prepare and follow up on quotations, proposals, invoices and other business documents.
	Prepare reports, spreadsheets and presentations for management using Microsoft Office.
	Liaise with clients, vendors, service providers and internal teams to ensure smooth coordination of activities.
	Maintain confidentiality of company and management information.
	Perform other administrative and business support duties as assigned by management.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration or a related field.
	2–5 years of experience in administration, executive support, office management or a similar role.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong organisational, multitasking and follow-up skills.
	Professional telephone and customer service skills.
	Ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet deadlines.
	High level of professionalism, discretion and attention to detail.


Technical Skills:


	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
	Good email, calendar and digital file management skills.
	Ability to prepare professional reports, quotations, spreadsheets and presentations.


Salary
N150,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their  CV to: [email protected] or [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at  E' Girls Right Foundation
content:
The E' Girls Right Foundation (EGRF) is a registered non-profit organization in Nigeria that champions the rights, health, and general well-being of women and young girls.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Primary School Teacher

Job Location: Agbarho, Ughelli North, Delta

Requirements
     

            
    




	NCE (Nigeria Certificate in Education) - minimum professional teaching qualification for Basic Education.
	B.Ed., B.A. (Ed.), B.Sc.(Ed.) or equivalent education Degree preferred.
	Graduates in relevant subjects may apply where they possess PGDE / PDE or another recognised teaching qualification.
	Relevant subject specialisation for JSS teaching.
	TRCN registration / licence required or strongly preferred, with applicable professional registration requirements.
	Strong knowledge of the Nigerian Basic Education Curriculum and effective classroom practice.
	Good communication, classroom management, assessment and child-centred teaching skills.
	Relevant teaching experience is an advantage.


We are Looking For:


	Dedicated
	Competent
	Innovative
	Responsible
	Student-centred Teachers.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a one page Application Letter to: [email protected] using "Application for Teaching Position" as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Junior Secondary School (JSS) Teacher

Job Location: Agbarho, Ughelli North, Delta

Requirements


	NCE (Nigeria Certificate in Education) - minimum professional teaching qualification for Basic Education.
	B.Ed., B.A. (Ed.), B.Sc.(Ed.) or equivalent education Degree preferred.
	Graduates in relevant subjects may apply where they possess PGDE / PDE or another recognised teaching qualification.
	Relevant subject specialisation for JSS teaching.
	TRCN registration / licence required or strongly preferred, with applicable professional registration requirements.
	Strong knowledge of the Nigerian Basic Education Curriculum and effective classroom practice.
	Good communication, classroom management, assessment and child-centred teaching skills.
	Relevant teaching experience is an advantage.


We are Looking For:


	Dedicated
	Competent
	Innovative
	Responsible
	Student-centred Teachers.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a one page Application Letter to: [email protected] using "Application for Teaching Position" as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.) Live-in House Mistress

Job Location: Agbarho, Ughelli North, Delta

Requirements


	Female candidates with relevant experience in student welfare, discipline and boarding house management are encouraged to apply.


We are Looking For:


	Dedicated
	Competent
	Innovative
	Responsible
	Student-centred individuals.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a one page Application Letter to: [email protected] using "Application for Live-in House Mistress" as the subject of the email.

Note: Female candidates with relevant experience in student welfare, discipline and boarding house management are encouraged to apply.
